verticalDatum: Decoded 2017–2019 Scottish Phase4 DTM working datum. Catalog exposes EPSG27700 horizontally; source vertical transformation/vintage at the individual castle cells not independently certified.
sourceRasterEncoding: Native Float32 EPSG27700 DTM; valid pixels bilinear at centers. Nodata pixels filled for diagnostics from nearest valid pixel within18.742m; retained raw cropped nodata remains unchanged.

metadata.title: Scotland Lidar Phase 4 DTM NS79SE
metadata.abstract: The Scottish Public Sector LiDAR (Phase 4) was initially captured by Fugro for Scottish Power Energy Network (SPEN) from 2017 to 2019 to monitor their overhead power cable network under their Virtual World Asset Management programme. The Scottish Government procured this dataset with a contribution from SEPA for public use in 2019. This dataset covers total 17,945 square kilometres (note the dataset does not have full national coverage). This dataset reflects the Digital Terrain Model (DTM) produced from the point cloud data.

sources.transform: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of OSGB36 to WGS 84 (9) + British National Grid

limits: Four-meter local diagnostic grid resamples 0.5m DTM; native cell size is not a guarantee of positional/survey accuracy. OSTN15 horizontal operation reports1m accuracy; vertical datum and individual-cell acquisition date unverified.
Nodata beneath removed buildings and narrow gaps is bounded nearest-valid interpolation for diagnostics; raw cropped Float32 evidence retains all nodata. No roof heights are inferred from nodata.

Terrace levels and exterior heights remain authored approximations; retained ground supplies core foundation/entrance and lower-bailey contact. Volcanic cliff is host terrain, not a copied surveyed castle mesh.
Rejected first Terrarium datum79.6058m and coarse Copernicus DSM106.9468m; the latter includes buildings/vegetation and cannot be used directly as ground.
